proposals.title: Authorize roof repair — Building A
proposals.description: The building inspection report dated 2026-02-15 identified significant water intrusion at the Building A flat roof. This proposal authorizes up to $12,000 from the capital reserve fund for emergency repairs. Work to be performed by Harbor Roofing LLC per quote HH-2026-14. Sunita Kapoor (Treasurer) has confirmed reserve fund balance of $48,000.
proposals.narrative_hook: Did the thing we voted on actually happen, and can we prove it?

proposals.title: Q1 2026 patronage distribution — 3,840 credits across 524 labor hours
proposals.description: Q1 has closed. Total distributable surplus is 3,840 credits, to be allocated proportionally to member labor hours. Allocation formula: (member_hours / 524) * 3840. Rosa Mendez (Treasurer) has verified the figures.
proposals.narrative_hook: Why did this member get this distribution?

proposals.title: Authorize equipment-sharing agreement: River City Tool Library ↔ BrightWorks Cooperative
proposals.description: River City Tool Library provides access to metalworking equipment (lathe, drill press, metal bandsaw) during off-peak hours. BrightWorks Cooperative contributes 20 hours of maintenance labor per quarter. Agreement term: 90 days renewable. Facilitated by Finger Lakes CDN. Each party must independently ratify.
proposals.river_city_provides: Metalworking equipment access during off-peak hours
proposals.narrative_hook: How do independent co-ops work together without creating another bureaucracy?
